stories.title: Holmes Debut Recap — 4 IP, 4 ER in Shaky Return
stories.angle: Clay Holmes made his Cubs debut Saturday night after fracturing his fibula in May. The rust was evident: 4 innings, 4 ER, 6H, 2BB, 1K on 70 pitches. Jac Caglianone crushed two HRs to pace the Royals. Seth Lugo outpitched Holmes. Win streak ended at five. No final score per has_score=False insight — lead with Holmes' line and set up Boyd today.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Clay Holmes came back from a fractured fibula — and his first Cubs start showed it.

4 innings, 4 runs allowed, 70 pitches. Jac Caglianone crushed two HRs off him to pace the Royals.

The good news: it's one start. Boyd gets the ball today at 1:10 PM CT.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
